Hi Jordan

Great summary, thanks. A few follow-ups from InfoSec / Procurement: 

1) SOC 2: Please confirm whether Redwood has a SOC 2 Type II report (most recent period). We need the attestation PDF and the auditor name.

2) Incident response / breach notification: Please provide your standard breach notification SLA. Specifically: what triggers customer notification, typical time-to-notify after confirmation, and the expected point(s) of contact for GreenBank.

3) BCP / DR evidence: We typically ask for an overview of RTO/RPO targets and recent DR test evidence (summary). A redacted runbook excerpt that shows the escalation path and recovery steps is helpful.

4) Vendor security questionnaire: Procurement has attached our standard questionnaire; can you confirm a single point-of-contact who will lead completion and an estimated turnaround (we typically expect 5-10 business days for new vendors).

Please see attached: GreenBank_Vendor_Security_Questionnaire.xlsx (filled by procurement). We’ve cc’d procurement on this thread.

Thanks,

Alice

Thanks - attaching the items requested and answering the bullets inline below.

Attachments (stubs):
- redwood_SOC2-2026-TypeII.pdf (SOC 2 Type II report, redacted; auditor: Clearview Audit LLP)
- redwood_IR_runbook_excerpt.pdf (redacted excerpt showing escalation & notification contacts)

SOC 2: We completed a SOC 2 Type II audit covering 2025-2026; auditor listed above. Please treat the PDF as redacted for customer distribution; happy to coordinate any in-person or NDA'd reviews if needed.

Incident response / breach notification: Our standard process is: 
- We triage and confirm incidents internally; for incidents affecting customer data/confidentiality we notify impacted customers once a material impact is confirmed.
- Notification target: within 72 hours of confirmed customer-impacting incident. In practice, we aim for earlier notification where feasible and will provide status updates during investigation.
- Point(s) of contact: security@redwood.ai (InfoSec escalation) and I can be the primary for coordination with GreenBank (jordan.blake@redwood.ai).

BCP / DR evidence: The attached IR runbook excerpt includes our escalation ladder and the DR playbook summary. For RTO/RPO: typical inference control-plane failover RTO ~30m (for multi-region deployments); data restoration RTO varies by retention tier; details in the shared evidence folder.

Vendor questionnaire: Marissa will coordinate completion of the spreadsheet and legal will review any responses that touch on contractual commitments. Estimated turnaround: initial completion within 5 business days (by 3/19), final responses after legal review within 10 business days.

Related links:
- HubSpot record: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/123456/company/GB-4762
- Evidence folder (redwood shared drive): https://drive.redwood.ai/drive/folders/IR-BCP-evidence

Happy to jump on the follow-up call - I’m available Tue 3/16 09:00-10:00 PT or Wed 3/17 13:00-14:00 PT. Which works best for your team?

Thanks,
Jordan Blake
Senior Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.ai

Attachments: redwood_SOC2-2026-TypeII.pdf, redwood_IR_runbook_excerpt.pdf
